dispute_ticket.description: I spilled a little bubble tea on the back seat but I was charged $60. The driver was rude and just wanted money. I should not pay anything, please remove the whole $60.

chat_logs.content: Seat is wet, I need to clean it. I will report to Ryde.
It is just a small spill lah.

app_events.details: Driver submitted claim: 3 photos (timestamps 20:52-20:54, car plate SMA 9981 U visible in photo 1) of drink spillage on rear seat; cleaning receipt from 'CleanPro Auto Care' dated 2026-10-04 for S$60.00 with company name, contact number, address and plate number.
Cleaning fee S$60.00 charged to rider R-7105.

cleaning_fee_max_food_drink_spill.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip when the mess is a food, groceries or drink spillage.

value: cleaning company receipt with name, contact, address and date
cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver must provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only.

cleaning_claim_submission_window_hours.text: Hours after the trip ends within which a driver must submit a cleaning claim. It governs driver claims only.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: The rider's own chat at 20:44 admits the drink fell, the claim has timestamped photos showing the plate and a compliant cleaning receipt, and it was filed within 48 hours, so a drink-spill cleaning fee is payable. But this trip's policy caps a food or drink spillage fee at S$40.00 and S$60.00 was charged. The rider owes S$40.00 and the S$20.00 above the cap is refunded; the driver's tone does not change the amount.
